accessControlAllowMethods.description: Request methods allowed by CORS, for `Access-Control-Allow-Methods`.

accessControlMaxAge.description: Seconds a CORS preflight request can be cached, for `Access-Control-Max-Age`.

stsSeconds.description: `max-age` of the `Strict-Transport-Security` header, in seconds. `0` disables it.

forceSTSHeader.description: Also add the `Strict-Transport-Security` header on plain HTTP requests.

customRequestHeaders.description: Headers added to the request, keyed by name. An empty value removes the header.

data.description: Settings of the middleware, depending on its `type`.

tc-basic-secure-headers.description: A middleware with basic security headers, shipped by common.

type.description: Type of the Middleware, for example `basicAuth` or `redirectScheme`. It decides which `data` keys are used, see [Traefik middlewares](/truecharts-common/ingressMiddlewares/traefik).

namespace.description: Namespace of the Middleware. Defaults to the release namespace.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the Middleware with the release fullname.

pluginName.description: Name of the plugin, as registered in Traefik.

api.description: URL of the geolocation API, with `{ip}` as the placeholder of the client IP.

allowLocalRequests.description: Allow requests from private networks without a lookup.

logLocalRequests.description: Log the requests from private networks.

logAllowedRequests.description: Log the requests that are allowed.

logApiRequests.description: Log the requests to the geolocation API.

apiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of a geolocation API request, in milliseconds.

cacheSize.description: Number of IP lookups that are cached.

forceMonthlyUpdate.description: Update the geolocation database at least once a month.

allowUnknownCountries.description: Allow requests whose country can not be determined.

unknownCountryApiResponse.description: Response of the geolocation API for an unknown country.

blackListMode.description: Block the listed countries, instead of allowing only them.

silentStartUp.description: Do not log the start of the plugin.

addCountryHeader.description: Add the country of the client as a request header.

countries.description: Country codes that are allowed, or blocked with `blackListMode`.

sourceRange.description: CIDRs that are allowed. Everything else is rejected.

depth.description: Position of the IP to use in `X-Forwarded-For`, counted from the right.

ipStrategy.description: How the client IP is taken from the request.

regex.description: Regular expression that is matched against the request URL.

replacement.description: Replacement of the matched URL, can use the groups of `regex`.

maxRequestBodyBytes.description: Maximum size of a request body, in bytes.

memRequestBodyBytes.description: Size of a request body kept in memory before it is buffered to disk, in bytes.

maxResponseBodyBytes.description: Maximum size of a response body, in bytes.

memResponseBodyBytes.description: Size of a response body kept in memory before it is buffered to disk, in bytes.

maxResponseBodySize.description: Maximum size of the response body of the authentication service, in bytes.

retryExpression.description: Retry when the expression matches the response, eg `IsNetworkError() && Attempts() < 2`.

address.description: URL of the authentication service the request is forwarded to.

authResponseHeadersRegex.description: Regular expression of the authentication response headers that are copied to the request.

trustForwardHeader.description: Trust the `X-Forwarded-*` headers of the request.

authResponseHeaders.description: Headers of the authentication response that are copied to the request.

authRequestHeaders.description: Request headers sent to the authentication service. Empty sends all.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip the verification of the certificate of the authentication service.

tls.description: TLS settings of the connection to the authentication service.

attempts.description: Number of attempts, including the first request.

initialInterval.description: Wait before the first retry, eg `100ms`.

excludednets.description: CIDRs that are skipped when the real IP is taken from `X-Forwarded-For`.

middlewares.description: Middlewares of a chain, applied in order. Only for `type: chain`.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix `name` with the release fullname. Set to `false` for a middleware that is not created by this chart.

prefix.description: Prefix added to the path of the request.

forceSlash.description: Make sure the path starts with a `/` after stripping.

users.description: Users of the basic authentication, as `username` and `password`. Do not set together with `secret`.

items.description: A user of the basic authentication.

secret.description: Name of an existing Secret with the users, in the Traefik `basicAuth` format. Do not set together with `users`.

average.description: Average number of requests allowed per second.

burst.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in a burst.

path.description: Path that replaces the path of the request.

modSecurityUrl.description: URL of the ModSecurity service the request is checked with.

timeoutMillis.description: Timeout of the requests to the ModSecurity service, in milliseconds.

maxBodySize.description: Maximum size of a request body sent to the plugin, in bytes.

enabled.description: Enable the plugin. Must be a boolean.

updateIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between the updates of the decisions in `stream` mode.

updateMaxFailure.description: Number of failed updates before all requests are blocked. `-1` never blocks.

defaultDecisionSeconds.description: Seconds a decision is cached when it has no duration.

httpTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of the requests to CrowdSec, in seconds.

crowdsecAppsecEnabled.description: Check requests with the CrowdSec AppSec component.

crowdsecAppsecHost.description: Host and port of the CrowdSec AppSec component.

crowdsecAppsecFailureBlock.description: Block requests when the AppSec component returns an error.

crowdsecAppsecUnreachableBlock.description: Block requests when the AppSec component can not be reached.

crowdsecLapiKey.description: Bouncer key for the CrowdSec Local API.

crowdsecLapiHost.description: Host and port of the CrowdSec Local API.

crowdsecLapiScheme.description: Scheme of the CrowdSec Local API, `http` or `https`.

crowdsecLapiTLSInsecureVerify.description: Skip the verification of the certificate of the CrowdSec Local API.

crowdsecCapiMachineId.description: Machine ID for the CrowdSec Central API.

crowdsecCapiPassword.description: Password for the CrowdSec Central API.

crowdsecCapiScenarios.description: Scenarios reported to the CrowdSec Central API.

forwardedHeadersTrustedIPs.description: IPs and CIDRs of trusted proxies, whose forwarded headers are used.

clientTrustedIPs.description: IPs and CIDRs that are never checked.

forwardedHeadersCustomName.description: Name of the header the client IP is read from.

remediationHeadersCustomName.description: Name of the header that carries the remediation of a request.

redisCacheEnabled.description: Cache the decisions in Redis, shared between Traefik instances.

redisCacheHost.description: Host and port of the Redis cache.

redisCacheDatabase.description: Database number of the Redis cache.

crowdsecLapiTLSCertificateAuthority.description: CA certificate to verify the CrowdSec Local API.

crowdsecLapiTLSCertificateBouncer.description: Client certificate of the bouncer for the CrowdSec Local API.

crowdsecLapiTLSCertificateBouncerKey.description: Client key of the bouncer for the CrowdSec Local API.

captchaSiteKey.description: Site key of the captcha provider.

captchaSecretKey.description: Secret key of the captcha provider.

captchaGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a solved captcha stays valid.

captchaHTMLFilePath.description: Path of the HTML page with the captcha.

banHTMLFilePath.description: Path of the HTML page shown to banned clients.

customRequestHeaders.description: Headers added to the request, keyed by name. An empty value removes the header.

customResponseHeaders.description: Headers added to the response, keyed by name. An empty value removes the header.

accessControlAllowHeaders.description: Request headers allowed by CORS, for `Access-Control-Allow-Headers`.

accessControlAllowMethods.description: Request methods allowed by CORS, for `Access-Control-Allow-Methods`.

items.description: A regular expression for an allowed origin.

accessControlAllowOriginListRegex.description: Regular expressions of the origins allowed by CORS.

accessControlExposeHeaders.description: Response headers exposed to the browser, for `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

accessControlMaxAge.description: Seconds a CORS preflight request can be cached, for `Access-Control-Max-Age`.

addVaryHeader.description: Add the `Vary` header to CORS responses.

allowedHosts.description: Host names that are allowed. Empty allows all.

hostsProxyHeaders.description: Headers that can hold the original host name.

sslProxyHeaders.description: Headers, with their values, that tell the request was made over HTTPS.

stsSeconds.description: `max-age` of the `Strict-Transport-Security` header, in seconds. `0` disables it.

forceSTSHeader.description: Also add the `Strict-Transport-Security` header on plain HTTP requests.

isDevelopment.description: Allow the headers settings to be ignored for development hosts.

app.description: Name of the app the Theme Park theme is applied to.

baseUrl.description: Base URL the Theme Park CSS is loaded from.

addons.description: Settings of the add-ons of the Theme Park plugin.

items.description: A rewrite of a response header.

header.description: Name of the response header that is rewritten.

regex.description: Regular expression that is matched against the request URL.

replacement.description: Replacement of the matched URL, can use the groups of `regex`.

data.description: Settings of the middleware, depending on its `type`.

additionalProperties.description: A Traefik Middleware, keyed by name.

type.description: Type of the Middleware. It decides which `data` keys are used.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Middleware. Defaults to the release namespace.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the Middleware with the release fullname.
